children: its board increased the authorization under its share repurchase program to $5M from $2.5M and extended the program through April 26, 2027.
The mobility company said about $3.8M remained available for repurchases as of September 9. The Board maintained the existing $6.00 per-share ceiling for repurchases.
The timing and size of any future repurchases will depend on factors including Marti Technologies'
capital needs, market conditions, share price, available liquidity, debt, and other factors.
Since launching the buyback program in January 2024, Marti Technologies
has repurchased 795,467 shares for about $1.6M, at an average price of $1.95 per share.

title: Marti doubles share repurchase authorization to $5M
